patch_description: Compose the two 0.65-anchor lineages: (a) replace the single fixed-scale SG polish with a percentile-blended 3-scale SG kernel bank (half-widths [sg_half//2, sg_half, 3·sg_half/2]) with Gaussian weights centered at the 20/50/80th percentiles of local volatility, then (b) add a short fixed second SG cascade (h=window_size//8) that cascaded short kernels use to kill residual ripple causing spurious slope reversals, and (c) add a confidence-gated lead using the RTS slope channel, lightly polished and MAD-gated via tanh, so lag compensation applies only where the trend is statistically significant. This targets the untried Pareto point between the 0.65 anchors: keeping noise reduction 0.82 while pushing lag below 0.27 and false reversals below 45.
